newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen shares under surveillance -- TSE.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen shares under surveillance -- TSE.

text.p: Shares in Gajoen Kanko KK will be placed under surveillance from Tuesday morning until it is decided whether or not the firm will delist from Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE), the exchange said.
Trading in the shares was suspended on Monday due to unclear details of tax-related issues.

The TSE said trading was resuming on Tuesday. It said the shares were being put under surveillance after the hotel operator admitted it had overdue taxes totalling about 13 billion yen, including taxes in arrears.

Gajoen has not yet decided how it will pay the taxes, but it will try to come up with plans for payment in a business restructuring plan it will work out in the near future, Gajoen director Minoru Kato told a news conference earlier.
